verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's first-party pages document a hardware media engine: a ninth-gen NVENC encoder for fast video exports and AI effects in DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere. They also describe NVIDIA Studio acceleration for video editing, 3D rendering and graphic design. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC codec support, documentation of Studio or ISV-certified drivers, decoder details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of creator-app acceleration.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it

citations.quote: Harness the power of the ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder (NVENC) for blazing-fast video exports and AI-driven effects in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere, and more.
NVIDIA Studio is your creative advantage. GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs unlock transformative performance in video editing, 3D rendering, and graphic design.
